authority: Navigation layer: which repository objects describe the same discrepancy in which coordinates, and how they are related. A crosswalk records an identity, bound or implication with its status; a navigation path through the atlas is not a proof, and NOT_EQUIVALENT edges are barriers. Lean status is checked lexically against main; mathematical status of open statements lives in docs/proof-obligations.json.
phenomenon: One phenomenon, many coordinates: the square-root-scale fluctuation of the primes (pi - Li_2) and of the Mobius function (M), both governed by the nontrivial zeros of zeta. RH <=> each anchor fluctuates at the square-root scale. Every coordinate below reaches an anchor through typed crosswalks.

coordinates.name: Prime-counting discrepancy pi - Li_2
coordinates.definition: Delta(x) = pi(x) - Li_2(x), Li_2(x) = int_2^x dt/log t (repository normalization).
coordinates.index: real x >= 4 (pi evaluated at floor x)
coordinates.normalization: Classical li = li(2) + Li_2 with li(2) = 1.045163780...; see CONV-LI-VS-LI2.
coordinates.measures: The prime-side face of the phenomenon: RH <=> Delta(x) = O(sqrt(x) log x).

coordinates.name: Mertens function M
coordinates.definition: M(x) = sum_{n<=x} mu(n); energy form |M(x)|^2 <= C (x+1)^(1+eps).
coordinates.measures: The Mobius-side face: RH <=> M(x) = O(x^(1/2+eps)).

coordinates.name: Nontrivial zeta zeros / rightmost real part
coordinates.definition: Theta = sup { Re rho : zeta(rho) = 0, 0 < Re rho < 1 }; RH <=> Theta = 1/2.
coordinates.measures: The common analytic source of both anchors.

coordinates.name: Logarithmic integral model Li_2
coordinates.definition: Li_2(x) = int_2^x dt/log t.
coordinates.measures: Deterministic prime-count model; no arithmetic content.

coordinates.name: Legacy midpoint VF (vfMid)
coordinates.definition: vfMid(x) = sum_{r=2}^{R-1} (2r+1)/log(r^2+r+1/2) + (x-R^2)/log((R^2+x)/2), R = floor(sqrt x).
coordinates.measures: Square-tiled deterministic model of pi; legacy internal coordinate.

coordinates.name: Canonical VF (vfCanonical)
coordinates.definition: VF_can(x) = vfMid(x) + sqrt 2; VF_can(R^2) = F_R + sqrt 2.
coordinates.measures: The unique public VF; differs from Li_2 by O(1) on every real x >= 4.

coordinates.name: VF finished mass and block mass
coordinates.definition: F_R = sum_{2<=r<R} V_r, V_r = m_r = (2r+1)/log(r^2+r+1/2); w_R = m_R/R.
coordinates.measures: Deterministic per-block demand matched against actual block prime counts.

coordinates.name: pi - VF on the real line
coordinates.definition: pi(x) - VF_can(x) (canonical) or pi(x) - vfMid(x) (legacy).
coordinates.measures: Delta(x) minus the bounded deterministic quadrature VF_can - Li_2.

coordinates.name: Canonical square-endpoint defect D_R^can
coordinates.definition: D_can(R) = pi(R^2) - F_R - sqrt 2 = pi(R^2) - VF_can(R^2).
coordinates.measures: Delta sampled at square endpoints, shifted by a bounded deterministic term; the public RH target.

coordinates.name: Legacy raw square-endpoint defect D_raw
coordinates.definition: D_raw(R) = pi(R^2) - F_R.
coordinates.measures: Same as D_can up to the fixed offset sqrt 2; the #915 historical coordinate.

coordinates.name: Actual primes per square block P_R
coordinates.measures: Increment of pi across one square block; drives the defect recurrence.

coordinates.name: Floor-Li integer model Q(n)
coordinates.definition: Q(n) = floor(Li_2(n)); integer potential of the floor-Li staircase.
coordinates.measures: Integer rounding of Li_2; a model, never actual-prime membership.

coordinates.name: Prime vs floor-Li event stream eta
coordinates.measures: Pointwise increments of pi - Q; every prime-side statistic is a weighted sum of eta.

coordinates.name: Floor-Li block prime defect D_r (zeroth moment)
coordinates.measures: Block count of signed mismatches; loses within-block locations.

coordinates.name: Johnston cumulative statistic G and displacement J_r
coordinates.measures: Cesaro (first-moment) projection of Delta; RH <=> eventual G(R^2) < 0 (Johnston, paper transfer).

coordinates.name: Johnston integral H(X)
coordinates.definition: H(X) = int_2^X (pi(t) - li(t)) dt (classical li).
coordinates.measures: Continuous first moment of Delta; Johnston: RH <=> H(X) < 0 for all X > 2.

coordinates.name: Original #915 first-bad weighted source
coordinates.definition: Source(R) = D_raw(R+1) = D_raw(R) + P_R - m_R; TotalMass(R) = (|D_raw(R)| + beta_R)^2, beta_R = m_R + (1 - 2 w_R) P_R; native VF weights, masks, clipping, anchors, NNS denominators.
coordinates.index: integer R >= 8 (first-bad successor R+1 at K = 2)
coordinates.measures: Weighted, masked quadratic first-bad statistic on the raw defect; not the unweighted Mertens kernel.

coordinates.name: Raw odd-seat factor-depth ledger L_R = T_R + H_R
coordinates.definition: c(r,n) = w_r - 1_prime(n) on odd seats r^2 < n < (r+1)^2; L_R = sum c = T_R (prime tags) + H_R (positive composite seats).
coordinates.measures: Seat-level weighted model-minus-prime ledger; D_can(R) = 2 - sqrt2 - L_R (paper).

coordinates.name: Least-prime owner census P_R = R - C_R
coordinates.definition: For the R odd interior seats of (R^2,(R+1)^2): P_R = R - C_R with C_R the seats removed by their unique least prime owner.
coordinates.measures: Unsigned population accounting of the block prime count; S = A - T carrier #1.

coordinates.name: von Mangoldt / Chebyshev psi
coordinates.definition: Lambda(n) = log p on prime powers; psi(x) = sum_{n<=x} Lambda(n).
coordinates.measures: Prime-power weighted prime count; psi(x) - x is the classical twin of Delta.

coordinates.name: Mertens prime-reciprocal error E_prime
coordinates.definition: E_prime(y) = sum_{p<=y} 1/p - log log y - M_Meissel.
coordinates.measures: Band oscillation in the raw ledger: T_R - M_R^band = F_R (E_prime(2R-1) - E_prime(R-1)) + rho_R (paper).

coordinates.name: Mertens at square endpoints
coordinates.definition: X_R = R^2 - 1 (squareRootEndpoint R); squarePrefixMertens n = M((n+1)^2 - 1).
coordinates.normalization: Index shift: squarePrefixEndpoint n = (n+1)^2 - 1 but squareRootEndpoint R = R^2 - 1; see CONV-SQUARE-ENDPOINT.
coordinates.measures: M sampled just below each square; the Mobius analogue of the VF square endpoint.

coordinates.name: Diagonal + signed pair covariance of mu
coordinates.definition: D(N) = sum_{n<=N} mu(n)^2, C(N) = sum_{a<b<=N} mu(a) mu(b); M(N)^2 = D(N) + 2 C(N).
coordinates.measures: Quadratic (energy) face of M; C(N) is not a Pearson correlation.

coordinates.name: Weighted Mertens energy E_eps(T)
coordinates.definition: E_eps(T) = sum_{n<=T} M(n)^2/n^(2+2eps) = D_eps(T) + 2 C_eps(T).
coordinates.measures: Mellin-weighted energy; uniform bound at every eps > 0 is RH-equivalent.

coordinates.name: Zero-target NNS co-partial moments (Co/Div)
coordinates.definition: For a pair (x, y): x*y = CUPM + CLPM - DLPM - DUPM about target 0 (Co = CUPM + CLPM, Div = DUPM + DLPM).
coordinates.measures: Sign-split coordinates for any signed product sum; the #915 source uses a weighted, normalized version.

coordinates.name: Square-shell Mobius mass
coordinates.definition: delta_R = sum of mu over the shell [R^2, (R+1)^2) (vf919SquareShellSum, half-open) or (r^2, (r+1)^2) (strict, energy notes).
coordinates.normalization: Half-open vs strict shells differ by the square endpoint; see CONV-SQUARE-SHELL.
coordinates.measures: Block increments of M; sum over shells telescopes to M.

coordinates.name: Signed smooth-minus-transport S = A - T
coordinates.definition: M(R^2-1) = A_mu(R) - T_mu(R), A_mu(R) = sum_{m<=X, P+(m)<=R} mu(m), T_mu(R) = sum_{R<q<=X prime} M(floor(X/q)).
coordinates.measures: S = A - T carrier #2: genuine signed Mobius, not the prime census or the Hecke transform.

coordinates.name: Excluded-six Hecke coefficient a6 and quotient kernel K
coordinates.definition: a6 = 1_{gcd(n,6)=1} (mu * (chi_{-3} mu)); M(X) = sum_m a6(m) K(floor(X/m)) with a period-36 kernel K; at y = floor(sqrt X), M = P0 - 2 P1.
coordinates.measures: S = A - T carrier #3 (normalized Hecke transform); quotient-bucket variation bounds M.

coordinates.name: Finite A/C historical envelope
coordinates.measures: M at the square endpoint normalized by its own historical maximum.

coordinates.name: Legal live-packet ancestry Gram
coordinates.definition: M(X_R)^2 = L_R + 2 Gamma_R over legal live odd packets.
coordinates.measures: Packet-Gram face of the finite-A endpoint numerator.

coordinates.name: Euler self-dual bilinear / Newton-lift double sum
coordinates.definition: Q_{R-1}(R^2-1) = sum_{a,b<R} mu(a) mu(b) floor((R^2-1)/(ab)) = sum_{n<=X} (P_R*P_R*zeta)(n) = 2M(R-1) - M(R^2-1).
coordinates.measures: The finite-C quantity Q_R written as the k = 2 Newton-lift / Euler-product bilinear.

coordinates.name: CORR-4 rough correlation C_R
coordinates.definition: C_R = squareRootCanonicalRoughCorrelation R = M(R-1) - M(R^2-1).
coordinates.measures: Parent endpoint excursion of M across the square root.

coordinates.name: CORR-4 low q^2 daughters (E_R, U_R)
coordinates.definition: Y_q = floor(X_R/q^2), q odd prime with q^2 < R; E_R = sum M(Y_q)^2; U_R = sum M(Y_q)/q.
coordinates.measures: M at the q^2-rescaled endpoints: the recursion's children.

coordinates.name: CORR-4 physical remainder B_R and first-owner Gram
coordinates.definition: B_R = C_R - U_R; |B_R|^2 = D_R + 2 Gamma_R with D_R the weighted Mobius diagonal and Gamma_R the first-owner Gram.
coordinates.measures: What is left of the parent excursion after the daughter synthesis; at least 12 Lean rewrites exist.

coordinates.name: PNT-first cofactor split M = S - L - E
coordinates.definition: M(X) = S_R - L_R - E_R, S_R = sum_{P+(n)<R} mu(n), L_R = sum_{c<R} mu(c)(Li_2(t_c) - Li_2(R-1)), E_R = sum_{c<R} mu(c)(Delta(t_c) - Delta(R-1)), t_c = floor(X/c).
coordinates.measures: Writes M through cofactor-weighted Li model plus the prime discrepancy Delta: a direct prime/Mobius coupling.

coordinates.name: Buchstab floor-Li brackets
coordinates.definition: M(x) = smooth bracket + innovation bracket, the innovation being sum_{y<q<=x} (prime-minus-floor-Li weight)(q) * M(floor(x/q)).
coordinates.measures: Exact bilinear coupling of the prime/floor-Li mismatch with Mertens prefixes.

coordinates.name: Full-prefix amplitude E(B) and Newton/Heath-Brown lift
coordinates.definition: E(B) = max_{1<=n<B} |M(n)|/sqrt(n); M(X) = 2M(N) + K1 - K2 + K3 for N = B - 1, B <= X < B^2.
coordinates.measures: Normalized running maximum of |M|; a subcritical recurrence E(B^k) <= G E(B)^r, r < k, would give RH.

coordinates.name: Mertens growth exponent
coordinates.definition: lambda_M = limsup log|M(n)| / log n.
coordinates.measures: Exponent bookkeeping of M; equals Theta (Lean).

coordinates.name: Original OpenAI compensated ideal-labelled source
coordinates.definition: Ideal-labelled Gaussian/Hecke source with marked-minus-rescaled compensation, split/inert labels and sextic detector (research/oai_434).
coordinates.measures: Analytic zero-detector source behind the imported 7/8 theorem.

coordinates.name: Quasi-Riemann Tracker all-Dirichlet boundary
coordinates.definition: External tracker-certified zero-free boundary for all Dirichlet L-functions (0.8746075 at the 2026-10-26 note), a benchmark beside the imported 7/8.
coordinates.measures: External exponent benchmark; not an RH_Lean theorem.

coordinates.name: Nyman-Beurling distance d_N
coordinates.definition: d_N = distance in L^2 from 1 to the span of integer-dilation fractional-part functions up to N.
coordinates.measures: Hilbert-space face: RH <=> d_N -> 0 (Baez-Duarte).

crosswalks.formula: Delta(x) = pi(x) - Li_2(x)
VF_can(x) = vfMid(x) + sqrt 2
|VF_can(x) - Li_2(x)| <= C for every real x >= 4
crosswalks.caveat: Deterministic; says nothing about pi.

crosswalks.formula: pi - Li_2 = (pi - VF_can) + (VF_can - Li_2) at every real x
pi(x) - VF_can(x) at x = R^2 equals D_can(R)
(exists C, |D_can(R)| <= C R log R) <=> (exists C', |Delta(x)| <= C' sqrt(x) log x)
crosswalks.caveat: Existential constants change; fixed-constant statements are not preserved.

crosswalks.formula: D_can(R) = D_raw(R) - sqrt 2
crosswalks.caveat: Squares carry -2 sqrt2 D_raw + 2; fixed-K first-bad energies are not phase invariant.

crosswalks.formula: D_can(R+1) = D_can(R) + (P_R - V_R)
VF_can(R^2) = F_R + sqrt 2

crosswalks.caveat: Rounding of the model, not prime-counting control.

crosswalks.formula: eta(k) = 1_prime(k) - (Q(k) - Q(k-1))
signed mismatch mass on [A^2, B^2) = -(dyadic prime defect)
crosswalks.caveat: Zeroth moment: within-block arrival locations are lost.

crosswalks.formula: historical moving-owner correction on [A,B) = -(signed floor-Li population balance on [A^2,B^2))
crosswalks.caveat: Aggregate only; native weights, masks, clipping, anchors and NNS terms are not carried.

crosswalks.formula: Source(R) = D_raw(R+1) = D_raw(R) + P_R - m_R

crosswalks.caveat: Claim 20261024-owner-1 (agent-reports); first moment, review pending.

crosswalks.formula: G(N) = sum_{n<N} Delta(n) + O(N)
crosswalks.caveat: Cesaro projection; not pointwise-invertible.

crosswalks.formula: H(X) - G(floor X) = O(X) (li vs Li_2 and the -1 centering)
H(X) = int_2^X (pi - li) = int_2^X Delta - li(2)(X - 2)
D_can(R) = 2 - sqrt 2 - L_R
crosswalks.caveat: Paper-level telescoping under the stated endpoint conventions; not compiled.

crosswalks.formula: T_R - M_R^band = F_R (E_prime(2R-1) - E_prime(R-1)) + rho_R, rho_R = O(R/log^2 R)
crosswalks.caveat: Self-audited paper claim; band relative to its prime-free model only.

crosswalks.formula: primes among the R odd interior seats = R - C_R (least-prime owner removal)
crosswalks.caveat: Unsigned population accounting.

crosswalks.formula: Delta(x) = O(x^(Theta+eps)) and Delta(x) = Omega_+-(x^(Theta-eps)); RH <=> Delta = O(sqrt x log x) (von Koch 1901)
crosswalks.caveat: In Lean only through the explicit ClassicalVonKochRHCriterion interface.

crosswalks.formula: lambda_M = limsup log|M(n)|/log n
lambda_M = Theta
crosswalks.caveat: Identifies boundaries; supplies no numerical value.

crosswalks.formula: sum_{d<=X} Lambda(d) M(floor(X/d)) = -sum_{n<=X} mu(n) log n
partial summation: psi(x) - x = O(x^a log^2 x) <=> Delta(x) = O(x^a log x) for a >= 1/2
M(x) = smooth bracket + innovation bracket at y = floor(sqrt x), exact for x >= 1
actual prime tail = floor-Li reference + sum_q (prime-minus-floor-Li weight)(q) M(floor(x/q))
crosswalks.caveat: Bilinear in (mismatch, Mertens prefix); no norm taken.

crosswalks.formula: squarePrefixMertens n = M((n+1)^2 - 1)
M(R^2 - 1) = A_mu(R) - T_mu(R)
each pair product mu(a) mu(b) = CUPM + CLPM - DLPM - DUPM at target 0
crosswalks.caveat: The #915 NNS statistic is weighted and normalized differently; this is only the pairwise sign split.

crosswalks.formula: E_eps(T) = sum M(n)^2/n^(2+2eps) = D_eps(T) + 2 C_eps(T)
sum over shells R < K of the shell source = realMertensLength(K^2), the true Mertens prefix of length K^2
M(X) = exact signed quotient buckets of a6 against the period-36 kernel

crosswalks.caveat: Scalar crosswalk, integer-verified; root cutoff R-1 vs historical q > R (CONV-ROOT-CUTOFF).

crosswalks.formula: Q_R = 2M(R-1) - M(R^2-1); numerator (M(R^2-1) - 1)^2; K_R from M(y), y < R
sum_{a,b<R} mu(a) mu(b) floor((R^2-1)/(ab)) = 2M(R-1) - M(R^2-1) = Q_R
(P_R * P_R * zeta)(n) = mu(n) for n < R, -mu(n) for R <= n < R^2 (Newton lift 2P - P*P*zeta = mu below R^2)
crosswalks.caveat: Support statement on coefficients, not a sign or norm estimate.

crosswalks.formula: Gamma_R <= B R^2 K_R (some B) <=> finite A (some A)
crosswalks.caveat: Existential equivalence on this normalized carrier only.

crosswalks.formula: finite A => |M(x)|^2 <= C (x+1)^(1+eps)
crosswalks.caveat: Converse not proved; finite A may be stronger than RH.

crosswalks.formula: bounded normalized rough correlation <=> Mertens energy statement
daughters are M(floor(X_R/q^2)) for odd primes q^2 < R

crosswalks.caveat: Frame-only arguments rehouse a finite-A excursion (claim 20261025-coordinator-1).

crosswalks.formula: B_R = rough correlation - reciprocal column (one of >= 12 Lean rewrites of B_R)
|B_R|^2 = D_R + 2 * (first-owner Gram)
crosswalks.caveat: A first-owner diagonal/off-diagonal split, the same shape as M^2 = D + 2C on a different carrier.

crosswalks.formula: CORR-4 (coefficient 4 on q^2 daughter energy) => finite A
M(X) = S_R - L_R - E_R, X = R^2 - 1
crosswalks.caveat: Exact identity, not an estimate.

crosswalks.formula: E_R = sum_{c<R} mu(c) (Delta(t_c) - Delta(R-1))
crosswalks.caveat: Fixed-c PNT is not uniform as c approaches R.

crosswalks.formula: E(B) = max_{1<=n<B} |M(n)|/sqrt(n)
zeta(s) != 0 for Re s > 7/8
crosswalks.caveat: Imported certified external proof; benchmark, not an exponent improvement.

crosswalks.formula: global signed covariance bound at exponent 7/8 + eps
crosswalks.caveat: Output-level; not coefficient-by-coefficient identification with RH_Lean owner coefficients.

crosswalks.formula: tracker-certified all-Dirichlet zero-free boundary (external)
crosswalks.caveat: External tracker certificate; not imported into RH_Lean.

crosswalks.formula: RH <=> d_N -> 0 (Baez-Duarte); d_N^2 >= c/log N (Burnol)
the weighted #915 first-bad source is not the unweighted smooth-minus-transport kernel
first moment vs zeroth moment: blocks r = 4, 7 have D_r = 0 and J_r = +4, -2
three S = A - T carriers (prime census, signed Mertens, Hecke) are not termwise or normwise identical
OAI ideal coefficients are not RH_Lean physical prime-owner coefficients

conventions.title: li versus Li_2
conventions.statement: Repository Li_2(x) = int_2^x dt/log t; classical li(x) = li(2) + Li_2(x), li(2) = 1.045163780...
conventions.pitfall: Johnston's all-X criterion uses li; replacing it by Li_2 is invalid. von Koch-scale statements are insensitive to the constant.

conventions.title: VF_mid versus VF_can (sqrt 2 phase)
conventions.statement: VF_can = vfMid + sqrt 2; D_can = D_raw - sqrt 2.
conventions.pitfall: Existence of a von Koch constant is phase invariant; fixed-K first-bad statements and squared energies are not ((D_raw - sqrt2)^2 = D_raw^2 - 2 sqrt2 D_raw + 2).

conventions.title: Square endpoints and index shifts
conventions.statement: VF endpoints are R^2; Mertens endpoints are X_R = R^2 - 1 = squareRootEndpoint R; squarePrefixEndpoint n = (n+1)^2 - 1 (shifted index).
conventions.pitfall: Mixing R^2 with R^2 - 1 or n with n + 1 silently moves one square block.

conventions.title: Hecke root cutoff R - 1 versus historical q > R
conventions.statement: At X = R^2 - 1, floor(sqrt X) = R - 1; the historical transport uses primes q > R.
conventions.pitfall: If R is a split prime, q = R is a live Hecke prime absent from the historical transform; the correction 1_{R prime}(1 + chi_{-3}(R)) M(R-1) is required (fails without it at R = 7, 13).

conventions.title: Half-open versus strict square shells
conventions.statement: vf919SquareShellSum uses [R^2, (R+1)^2); square-shell energy notes and raw odd seats use (r^2, (r+1)^2).
conventions.pitfall: For R >= 2, mu(R^2) = 0, so the two Mobius shell sums agree; seat counts, VF seat weights and closed-block telescopes still differ at the endpoints, and R = 1 has mu(1) = 1. Check the definition before transporting a bound.

conventions.title: Three different S = A - T
conventions.statement: (1) prime census P_R = R - C_R; (2) signed Mertens M(X) = A_mu - T_mu; (3) #919 Hecke four-shift transform.
conventions.pitfall: Shared notation is not a proof arrow; physical sites, coefficients and masks differ.

conventions.title: Raw covariance versus Pearson-type ratios
conventions.statement: C(N) = sum_{a<b} mu(a) mu(b) is unnormalized; rho_R = 2 U V/(U^2 + V^2) is a different two-aggregate normalization.
conventions.pitfall: rho_R near -1 does not imply an RH-scale bound on C(N) or M.

conventions.title: The -1 centerings
conventions.statement: Finite A uses (M(y) - 1)^2 and (M(R^2-1) - 1)^2; JOH uses B(n) = pi(n) - Q(n) - 1.
conventions.pitfall: The constant shifts are integral-stability or envelope conventions, not claims that M = 1 or pi = Q + 1.

conventions.title: mertensSummatory versus mertensSummatoryInt
conventions.statement: mertensSummatory is complex-valued (RHLean.Analysis); mertensSummatoryInt is integer-valued (RHLean.Proof).
conventions.pitfall: Rewrites found for one name do not automatically apply to the other; search both.
